Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> National Final day: Republic Bank-JoyNews Habitat Fair clinic in Ho closes on a high note with fun, big sales Source : Myjoyonline.com 18 October 2026 6:33pm Audio By Carbonatix
The Republic Bank–JoyNews Habitat Fair clinic in Ho has ended on a high note, with lively activities, exciting offers and strong sales marking the final day of the three-day event.
Held at the Ho Sports Stadium, the fair brought together businesses in the housing and real estate sector, offering prospective homeowners and property investors the opportunity to explore products and services to support their housing needs.
Exhibitors offered discounts of up to 30% on selected products and services, attracting patrons looking for affordable deals on housing-related purchases.
The exhibition featured a range of offerings, including building materials, home appliances, property development services and real estate financing options.
The final day provided visitors with an opportunity to engage directly with exhibitors, compare prices and explore available solutions, while businesses used the platform to showcase their products, connect with potential customers and boost sales.
Beyond the commercial activity, the fair offered an engaging atmosphere for patrons, combining business opportunities with fun as visitors explored the various exhibition stands.
Organised by JoyNews and sponsored by Republic Bank, the Habitat Fair seeks to connect consumers with businesses and service providers across Ghana’s housing and real estate industry.
The Ho edition also formed part of efforts to extend the fair beyond Accra and other major urban centres, bringing housing solutions and property-related services closer to prospective buyers in the Volta Region and surrounding communities.
The event’s conclusion marks another opportunity for exhibitors to reach new customers while helping patrons make informed decisions about homeownership, construction and property investment.
